title: Correct final force
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (1) must be F = 2.5 N.

title: Correct final impulse
description: Essential: The student's final answer for part (2) must be I_F = 6 N·s.

title: Apply Newton's second law
description: Important: The student must set up the equation F - F_A = ma, relating the applied force, Ampere force, and acceleration.

title: Calculate Ampere force correctly
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the Ampere force (F_A = BIL) using the induced current and rod length.

title: Calculate induced current
description: Important: The student must use motional EMF (E = BLv) and Ohm's law (I = E/(R+r)) to find the induced current.

title: Calculate impulse via momentum
description: Important: The student must correctly relate the impulse of the applied force to the change in momentum and the impulse of the Ampere force (I_F = mv + I_A).

title: Calculate Ampere force impulse
description: Optional: The student may show the calculation of the Ampere force's impulse via charge (I_A = BLq) and the relation q = ΔΦ/(R+r).

title: Use kinematics correctly
description: Optional: The student correctly uses kinematics (v = at, x = ½at²) to find velocity and displacement at t=4s.

title: Sign error in force equation
description: Pitfall: The student uses F + F_A = ma (wrong direction for Ampere force) instead of F - F_A = ma.

title: Omits internal resistance
description: Pitfall: The student calculates induced current as I = E/R, neglecting the rod's internal resistance (r).
